graded_findings.rationale: The generated repository index is required shared AI context, and the added cli/disk_report.py changed indexed source structure without the corresponding index update. That is a real docs/context adherence gap for this repository, not a cosmetic issue.

plan_kts:
fun plan(): Verdict {
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val gather = extractGather(taskContext)
    val feedback = extractFeedback(taskContext)
    val gradedFindings = gradeFindings(gather, feedback)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(gather, gradedFindings)
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "Docs-updated-appropriately judge evidence written; no GitHub action needed.")
    return evidence
}
